about: Whole-turn speedup, best-vs-best: min over the two shipped splits divided by min over the two composed ones, where a turn = median(append) + median(decode) over its reps and EXCLUDES the KV handoff on both models (metric decision). Also vs_default: the shipped default split with the census decode over the composed S4 with the renamed decode.
source: amd-npu c61445da turn-w3-1b.json and 171082f6 turn-w3-qwen.json, per-rep wall times; ratios re-derived in aie-cosched-paper-0 from those files

excluded.16384:4096 vs_default (1B): the shipped-S2 arm entered its slow state (append 12.8-13.1 s); best-vs-best is unaffected because the minimum takes the S4 arm

append_percentiles.note: TraceLab Table 8, new tokens per step
